Starships are vital to exploring the Galaxy. You can buy, find, and steal different starships, or build one yourself. 

There are multiple classes of starships: 

A - Low firepower but high mobility

B - Moderate firepower and moderate mobility

C - High firepower and low mobility

New ships can be purchased from Ship Services Technicians and Staryards in major cities throughout the galaxy.

You can modify your starships by visiting a Ship Services Technician. For more info, see the "Ship Modification" entry.

items.source_en:
The Niamos Group would like to remind you, our dedicated Hospitality Specialists, of four simple rules we'd like you to keep in mind as you make this resort a premium destination for our valued guests:

1. Always address guests with respect and warm smiles. Without our guests, we have no resort, and you don't have a job.

2. Cleanliness is key. The smallest speck of sand where it doesn't belong can ruin someone's day. If you see anything amiss, either clean it yourself, or report it to the nearest Sanitation Technician as soon as possible. This goes double for your personal hygiene.

3. Comfort, comfort, comfort. Always offer guests whatever accommodations they may need to be at their most comfortable. Don't shy away from upselling.

4. You are a representative of this resort, whether you're on the clock or not. You are free to relax in your off-hours, but you must always remain professional. Imagine the ideal guest, the kind that creates as few problems for you and your job as possible, and BE that guest.
items.legacy_ko:
니아모스 그룹은 우리 헌신적인 접객 전문가 여러분께, 이 리조트를 소중한 고객을 위한 최고급 목적지로 만들기 위해 명심해야 할 네 가지 간단한 규칙을 상기시켜 드립니다:

1. 항상 존중과 따뜻한 미소로 고객을 대하십시오. 고객이 없다면 우리 리조트도 없고, 여러분의 일자리도 없습니다.

2. 청결이 핵심입니다. 제자리에 있지 않은 작은 모래 알갱이 하나가 누군가의 하루를 망칠 수 있습니다. 잘못된 점을 발견하면 직접 치우거나, 가능한 한 빨리 가장 가까운 위생 기술자에게 보고하십시오. 개인 위생은 두말할 필요도 없습니다.

3. 편안함, 편안함, 또 편안함입니다. 고객이 가장 편안함을 느낄 수 있도록 필요한 모든 편의를 제공하십시오. 추가 판매를 주저하지 마십시오.

This is an exceptional site! Six Sisters should invest considerable time and resources into an outpost here. It'll take years to plumb this planet's depths. Analysis of nearby strata reveals traces of everything from gold to Raw Spice within half a klick of my landing site. 

The stone surrounding the site is mainly sedimentary, with some metamorphic rock detected deep in the planet's crust. I suspect this environment has been heavily shaped by water and wind. I've found no evidence of seismic or volcanic activity in the vicinity. The area's topography requires no significant modifications to facilitate the construction of an outpost.

Should Six Sisters wish to construct multiple outposts on this planet, I suggest looking for a suitable location to the east of this site. I've detected higher concentrations of minerals in the soil in that direction. 

PROPERTY OF SIX SISTERS. GEOLOGICAL SURVEY DATA IS PROPRIETARY AND CONFIDENTIAL

This is an exceptional site! Six Sisters should invest considerable time and resources into an outpost here. It'll take years to plumb this planet's depths. Analysis of nearby strata reveals traces of everything from gold to caesium within half a klick of my landing site. 

The stone surrounding the site is mainly sedimentary, with some metamorphic rock detected deep in the planet's crust. I suspect this environment has been heavily shaped by water and wind. I've found no evidence of seismic or volcanic activity in the vicinity. The area's topography requires no significant modifications to facilitate the construction of an outpost.

Should Six Sisters wish to construct multiple outposts on this planet, I suggest looking for a suitable location to the east of this site. I've detected higher concentrations of minerals in the soil in that direction.

items.source_en:
The following is the planned schedule for study of Species X-34c:

Length of experiment
=========================
Two weeks in confinement, with one hyperspace jump after the first week.

Blood extraction
=========================
Every two days. This is to monitor the creature's health and look for any abnormal changes due to space flight. Any life-threatening situations will require scientist approval before intervention.

Feeding schedule
=========================
The creature will subsist on a predetermined diet approved by the nutritionist back at the facility. Stool samples will be collected and analyzed daily.
items.legacy_ko:
X-34c 종 연구를 위한 계획된 일정은 다음과 같다:

실험 기간
=========================
2주간 격리, 첫 주 후 하이퍼스페이스 도약 1회.

채혈
=========================
이틀마다 실시. 생명체의 건강 상태를 모니터링하고 우주 비행으로 인한 비정상적인 변화를 확인하기 위함이다. 생명이 위험한 상황이 발생하면 개입하기 전에 과학자의 승인을 받아야 한다.

급여 일정
=========================
생명체는 시설 내 영양사가 승인한 정해진 식단으로 유지된다. 대변 샘플은 매일 수집하여 분석한다.
